title: The Establishment of Offices of Ministers Instrument, 2025

 Printed by The Government Printer, Dodoma by Order of Government 

GOVERNMENT NOTICE No. 685 published on. 19/12/2025 

THE CONSTITUTION OF THE UNITED REPUBLIC OF TANZANIA, 
1977 
(CAP. 2) 
________ 

INSTRUMENT 
______ 

(Made under Article 55(1)) 

THE ESTABLISHMENT OF OFFICES OF MINISTERS INSTRUMENT, 2025 

WHEREAS,  Article  55  of  the  Constitution  of  the  United  Republic  of 
Tanzania, 1977, hereinafter referred to as “the Constitution”, empowers 
the President to appoint Ministers to hold such offices of Ministers in the 
Government of the United Republic as he may determine; 

AND WHEREAS, consequent upon the need to strengthen the discharge 
of certain ministerial functions, I am minded to disestablish the Offices 
of Ministers so previously promulgated and to establish in lieu of them, 
the Offices of Ministers specified in the Schedule to this Instrument;  

NOW  THEREFORE,  in  the  exercise  of  the  powers  conferred  on  the 
President by  Article 55 of the Constitution and all powers enabling the 
President in that behalf, I, SAMIA SULUHU HASSAN, the President of 
the  United  Republic  of  Tanzania,  do  hereby  disestablish  all  Offices  of 
Ministers  specified  in  all  Instruments  previously  promulgated  and 
subsisting  immediately  before  the  coming  into  operation  of  this 
Instrument and establish in lieu thereof, the Offices of Ministers specified 
in the Schedule to this Instrument.
